column3: MT 24:2. Close to the Hebrew; “from after the Philistines” is rendered “from pursuing the Philistines.”
MT 24:3. “On the face of” is rendered “in front of,” and the place is given as “the Rocks of the Wild Goats.”
MT 24:4. “To cover his feet” (a euphemism) is rendered “to relieve himself.”
MT 24:5. NASB supplies “this is”; the Hebrew reads simply “Behold the day.”
MT 24:6. “David’s heart struck him” is rendered “David’s conscience bothered him.”
MT 24:10. “Words of someone” is rendered “words of men.”
MT 24:11. “It looked with compassion on you” is rendered “my eye had pity on you”; NASB supplies “my eye.”
MT 24:16. “Conduct my case” is rendered “plead my cause,” and “vindicate me from your hand” as “deliver me from your hand.”
MT 24:20. “Send him away on a good journey” is rendered “let him go away safely.”
MT 24:22. The oath formula “if you will cut off” is rendered as a negative (“that you will not cut off”).
